Tests fd_cost_tracker allocation, init, join, and basic error cases.

# Purpose
This file contains a small C test program for `fd_cost_tracker`. It starts the Firedancer runtime with `fd_boot`, parses command-line options for a workspace, page size, page count, CPU affinity, and workspace tag, then creates or attaches to a workspace with `fd_wksp_attach` or `fd_wksp_new_anonymous`. The program allocates memory for a cost tracker, checks the alignment and footprint values returned by `fd_cost_tracker_align` and `fd_cost_tracker_footprint`, and verifies error handling for invalid calls to `fd_cost_tracker_new` and `fd_cost_tracker_join`. It then creates and joins a valid `fd_cost_tracker_t` object, logs `pass`, and shuts the runtime down with `fd_halt`.
